description: Review capability registry. Each focus defines a review lens with trigger rules and reviewer instructions.

focuses.label: Correctness
focuses.description: Logic errors, edge cases, contract violations, error handling gaps, type safety issues

focuses.label: Simplicity
focuses.description: Over-engineering, dead code, unnecessary abstraction, complexity hotspots, YAGNI violations

focuses.label: Accessibility (a11y)
focuses.description: ARIA roles, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, contrast, screen-reader support

focuses.label: Security
focuses.description: Injection vectors, auth/authz gaps, secrets exposure, unsafe deserialization, CSRF/XSS, data leakage

focuses.label: Performance
focuses.description: N+1 queries, unnecessary allocations, blocking operations, bundle size, lazy loading opportunities

focuses.label: Maintainability
focuses.description: Naming clarity, coupling/cohesion, test coverage gaps, documentation, pattern consistency

focuses.label: Design Consistency
focuses.description: UI matches design tokens, spacing/sizing consistency, component API alignment, visual regression risk

focuses.label: Git Safety
focuses.description: Sensitive files in diff, large binary changes, .gitignore hygiene, commit message quality
